trigger: Plays immediately after defeating BEIGE™ in the grand finale.

lines.speaker: beige
lines.text: System error... Aesthetic standard lost... Restoring... saturation...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 8:59 AM. Sixty seconds to spare. Ashwath guides the crew to press Deploy.

lines.speaker: ashwath
lines.text: Production deployed! Zero downtime! The Final Cut is live across the globe!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Across Neo-Amritsar, radiant neon cyan, hot pink, and gold flood every street.

lines.speaker: manya
lines.text: Color has returned! The chai stalls and neon signs are burning bright again!

lines.speaker: sayam
lines.text: Bhai, cutting chai for the whole city! Put it on my tab. Le re!

lines.speaker: sehaj
lines.text: Render complete. Zero dropped frames. Clean form. Vajj.

lines.speaker: manvi
lines.text: Yippieeee! Look at this city! Beautiful, messy, chaotic human art!

lines.speaker: mansukh
lines.text: Babymonnsterrr! We shipped it! Now I can open thirty new prototype tabs!

lines.speaker: brahmansh
lines.text: GG thaa 🔫! Seamless continuity from start to finish. Masterpiece, bire!

lines.speaker: mishthi
lines.text: As if I care? But... our movie looks gorgeous. Here's celebratory chai.

lines.speaker: tushar
lines.text: Quiet on set! Picture wrap on BEIGE. Great job, crew. Proud of you all.

lines.speaker: ashwath
lines.text: Looking through the balcony telescope at the stars... we're so small, dost.

lines.speaker: ashwath
lines.text: Eighty years isn't enough to explore the cosmos. But we made this together.
